title: Mathematical Modelling of Viscoelastic Media Without Bulk Relaxation Via Fractional Calculus Approach
content: In the present paper, several viscoelastic models are studied for the cases when time-dependent viscoelastic operators are represented in terms of the fractional derivative Kelvin-Voigt, Scott Blair, Maxwell, and standard linear solid models. Using the algebra of dimensionless Rabotnov’s fractional exponential functions, time-dependent operators for Poisson’s ratios have been obtained and analyzed. It is shown that materials described by some of such models are viscoelastic auxetics, because Poisson’s ratios of such materials are time-dependent operators which could take on both positive and negative magnitudes.
